meta.rng: python random.Random(seed).sample(frame_sorted_by_id, len(frame)); take first n non-gated

rules.S-curated: author.lower() in curated_authors, non-gated; census unless curated_cap
rules.S-popular: top n non-gated by downloads (30d) excl. S-curated; ties downloads_all_time desc, id asc
rules.S-recent: top n non-gated by last_modified excl. S-curated/S-popular; ties id asc
rules.S-tail: first n non-gated of a seeded permutation of all ids not in the three frames above

meta.gated_policy: excluded from every sample and replaced by the next non-gated id in that stratum's order (rank or seeded permutation); skipped ids stay in the frame, listed in gated_skipped
